skillDailyDesc: Organize quick notes into a structured daily note: categorize, extract todos and highlights
skillMeetingDesc: Turn meeting notes into a structure of "Topics / Conclusions / Action items (owner + deadline)"
skillResearchDesc: Standard workflow for finding up-to-date information beyond the notebook: search → filter → read closely → cross-verify → save into notes
skillResearchBody:
When the user asks to research, find or summarize information from the internet (news, docs, reviews, references, etc.):
1. Clarify the question: be clear about what to answer; confirm the scope and purpose with the user when it is vague.
2. Design queries: build 2-3 complementary keywords (try both Chinese and English); add qualifiers (year, official, tutorial, review) when too broad.
3. Search & filter: use web_search; prefer official docs, authoritative media and original sources; avoid content farms and marketing pieces.
4. Read & verify: use web_fetch to read the full text of 2-3 high-quality sources; cross-verify key conclusions with at least two sources.
5. Organize output: structure with Markdown and cite source links for key facts; state clearly what cannot be verified — never fabricate.
6. Offer to save: proactively ask whether to save the results into notes (a document or today's daily note); write only after confirmation.
Notes:
- Retry with different keywords when results are poor; never fabricate.
- Switch to other sources when fetching fails (anti-scraping/login required); do not retry the same link repeatedly.
- Distinguish facts from opinions; note the query date for time-sensitive information.
skillsSectionIntro: When the user's task matches a skill, follow that skill's workflow.
tool.list_notebooks.label: List notebooks
tool.list_notebooks.desc: List all open notebooks in SiYuan (ids and names). You must get a notebook id before creating documents.
tool.create_notebook.label: Create notebook
tool.create_notebook.p.name: Notebook name
tool.rename_notebook.label: Rename notebook
tool.rename_notebook.p.name: New name
tool.remove_notebook.label: Delete notebook
tool.remove_notebook.desc: Delete a notebook and all its documents. Irreversible — highly destructive operation.
tool.search_docs.label: Search documents
tool.search_docs.desc: Search documents by file name keyword; returns the notebook id, path and human-readable path.
tool.list_docs.label: List documents
tool.list_docs.desc: List documents under a notebook (optional path prefix); returns document ids and paths.
tool.list_docs.p.path: Path prefix, e.g. /Daily; defaults to all
tool.create_note.label: Create document
tool.create_note.desc: Create a new document with Markdown in the given notebook. path is the document hierarchy path, e.g. "/Daily/2026/Sep 9".
tool.create_note.p.path: Document path starting with /; the last segment is the document title
tool.read_note.label: Read document
tool.read_note.desc: Read a full document and return its Markdown content. Requires the id of the document (or any block in it); the document id usually comes from root_id in search_notes results.
tool.read_note.p.doc_id: Document id or id of any block in it
tool.read_note.empty: Document {id} is empty or does not exist.
tool.rename_doc.label: Rename document
tool.rename_doc.desc: Change the document title (the last path segment).
tool.rename_doc.p.title: New title
tool.move_doc.label: Move document
tool.move_doc.desc: Move a document to another location: `to` is the target parent document id or target notebook id (move to root).
tool.move_doc.p.doc_id: ID of the document to move
tool.move_doc.p.to: Target parent document id or target notebook id
tool.remove_doc.label: Delete document
tool.remove_doc.desc: Delete an entire document. Irreversible — destructive operation.
tool.search_notes.label: Search notes
tool.search_notes.desc: Search blocks containing keywords across all SiYuan notes. Returns block id, document path, block type and content summary. Prefer a single keyword or phrase; multiple space-separated keywords use AND semantics.
tool.search_notes.truncated: (results truncated; narrow the keywords or reduce limit)
tool.read_block.label: Read block
tool.read_block.desc: Read the Kramdown content of a single block (more precise than reading a whole document).
tool.insert_block.label: Insert block
tool.insert_block.desc: Insert new Markdown block(s) at a position. Positioning: parent_id only = append to the end of the parent block/document (most common); parent_id + previous_id = insert after that block; parent_id + next_id = insert before that block (to insert at the very top, query the first child block id and pass it as next_id).
tool.insert_block.p.previous_id: Previous block id; the new block is inserted after it
tool.insert_block.needAnchor: Provide at least one of parent_id, previous_id, next_id
tool.update_block.label: Update block
tool.update_block.desc: Replace a block entirely with new Markdown/Kramdown content. Only leaf blocks (paragraphs, headings, etc.); read_note first to find the target block id when editing a document.
tool.update_block.p.block_id: ID of the block to replace
tool.delete_block.label: Delete block
tool.delete_block.desc: Delete the given block. Use remove_doc to delete documents. Destructive operation — user confirmation is requested first.
tool.delete_block.p.block_id: ID of the block to delete
tool.move_block.label: Move block
tool.move_block.desc: Move a block to a new position: previous_id places it after that block, parent_id makes it a child; provide at least one.
tool.move_block.p.block_id: ID of the block to move
tool.move_block.p.previous_id: ID of the block before the target position
tool.search_tags.label: Search tags
tool.search_tags.desc: Search tags in the workspace by keyword; returns tags with reference counts.
tool.search_tags.p.keyword: Keyword; leave empty to list all
tool.rename_tag.label: Rename tag
tool.rename_tag.desc: Rename a tag across the workspace.
tool.remove_tag.label: Remove tag
tool.remove_tag.desc: Remove a tag from the workspace (content is not affected).
tool.remove_tag.p.label: Tag name
tool.list_bookmarks.label: List bookmarks
tool.list_bookmarks.desc: List all bookmarks in the workspace.
tool.rename_bookmark.label: Rename bookmark
tool.remove_bookmark.label: Remove bookmark
tool.remove_bookmark.desc: Remove a bookmark (the bookmarked content is not affected).
tool.remove_bookmark.p.label: Bookmark name
tool.get_block_attrs.label: Get block attributes
tool.get_block_attrs.desc: Read the custom attributes (custom-*) of the given block.
tool.set_block_attrs.label: Set block attributes
tool.set_block_attrs.desc: Set custom attributes on the given block; keys must start with custom-, an empty value deletes the attribute.
tool.list_doc_assets.label: List document assets
tool.list_doc_assets.desc: List asset files referenced/contained by the given document.
tool.get_asset_content.label: Read asset content
tool.get_asset_content.desc: Read the content of a text asset file in the workspace (e.g. text/Markdown in assets).
tool.rename_asset.label: Rename asset
tool.create_daily_note.label: Create daily note
tool.create_daily_note.desc: Create (or get the existing) daily note for today in the given notebook; returns the document id. Must be called before writing daily notes.
tool.append_daily_note.label: Append to daily note
tool.append_daily_note.desc: Append Markdown content to the end of today's daily note in the given notebook.
tool.list_snapshots.label: List snapshots
tool.list_snapshots.desc: List snapshots of the local data repo (for data history/rollback reference).
tool.create_snapshot.label: Create snapshot
tool.create_snapshot.desc: Create a data snapshot of the whole workspace (indexing may take a while).
tool.query_sql.label: SQL query
tool.query_sql.desc: Run a read-only SQL (SELECT) query on the SiYuan block database; the table is blocks with fields id/root_id/box/type/content/hpath etc.
tool.query_sql.p.stmt: SELECT statement, e.g. SELECT id, hpath FROM blocks WHERE type='d' LIMIT 10
tool.query_sql.onlySelect: Only read-only SELECT queries are allowed
tool.web_search.label: Web search
tool.web_search.desc: Search the internet and return titles, links and snippets (preferred engine configurable in settings; falls back to other engines automatically). For information beyond the notebook; use web_fetch to read the full text of a result.
tool.web_search.empty: Web search found no results for "{query}". The network may be unavailable or blocked by search engines; check network/proxy settings and retry.
tool.web_search.useFetch: Use web_fetch to fetch the full text of a link.
tool.web_fetch.label: Fetch web page
tool.web_fetch.desc: Fetch the web page at a URL and return its plain-text body (scripts/styles removed). Pairs with web_search: search first, then fetch pages worth reading. Only publicly accessible pages are supported.
tool.web_fetch.p.max_length: Max body length in chars, default {max}
tool.web_fetch.urlInvalid: url must be an http(s) link
tool.web_fetch.failed: Failed to fetch ({url}): the network is unavailable or the site refused access. Check network/proxy settings.
tool.open_document.label: Open document
tool.open_document.desc: Open the given document in the SiYuan editor (by block id).
tool.focus_block.label: Focus block
tool.focus_block.desc: Scroll a block that is loaded in an editor into view and highlight it.
tool.focus_block.notLoaded: Block {id} is not loaded in any editor; open its document with open_document first.
tool.open_search.label: Open search
tool.open_search.desc: Open the SiYuan global search panel, optionally filling in a query.
tool.open_setting.label: Open settings
tool.open_setting.desc: Open the SiYuan settings window, optionally filtering settings items by keyword.
tool.open_setting.menuFailed: Failed to open the settings menu
tool.p.databaseId: Database ID (database_id / avID; find it by name via list_databases — not a document block id)
tool.list_databases.label: List databases
tool.list_databases.desc: List databases (attribute views) in the workspace with database_id, name, document path and views. Find the database_id by name with this tool before any row/column operation.
tool.list_databases.p.keyword: Keyword to filter databases by name; empty lists all
tool.get_database.label: Get database schema
tool.get_database.desc: Read a database (attribute view) structure: name, views and all columns (including select options). Call this before row operations to learn column names and types.
tool.get_database.title: Database "{name}"
tool.query_database.label: Query database rows
tool.query_database.desc: Read rows of a database table view; returns cell values and row_id for each row (row_id is required to update/remove rows).
tool.query_database.p.view_id: View id; empty uses the default table view
tool.query_database.p.query: Keyword to filter by primary key content; empty disables filtering
tool.query_database.noView: The database has no available view
tool.query_database.notTable: This view is not a table view; only table views are supported for now
tool.add_database_row.label: Add database row
tool.add_database_row.desc: Append a row to the database; values is keyed by column name, with values matching column types (text/number/date like 2026-01-02/checkbox boolean/select option name/multi-select option name array). Missing select/multi-select options are created automatically.
tool.add_database_row.p.values: Row values keyed by column name, e.g. {"Task": "Write report", "Status": "Doing"}
tool.update_database_cell.label: Update database cell
tool.update_database_cell.desc: Update one cell of a database row; row_id comes from query_database, column is the column name, value matches the column type. Missing select/multi-select options are created automatically.
tool.update_database_cell.p.value: New value, matching the column type
tool.remove_database_rows.label: Delete database rows
tool.remove_database_rows.desc: Delete rows from a database (row_id from query_database); only removes database rows, not any associated documents.
tool.remove_database_rows.p.row_ids: Array of row ids to delete
tool.add_database_column.label: Add database column
tool.add_database_column.desc: Add a column to the database; type can be text/number/select/mSelect/date/url/email/phone/checkbox/rating, etc.
tool.add_database_column.p.name: Column name
tool.add_database_column.p.type: Column type, e.g. text, number, select, mSelect, date, checkbox
tool.rename_database_column.label: Rename database column
tool.rename_database_column.desc: Rename a column of the database.
tool.remove_database_column.label: Delete database column
tool.remove_database_column.desc: Delete a column and all its data from the database. Irreversible — destructive operation.
tool.av.unknownColumn: Column "{name}" does not exist in the database. Available columns: {columns}
tool.av.readonlyType: Column "{name}" of type {type} does not support writing
tool.av.badDate: Cannot parse the date value for column "{name}": {value}
tool.create_database.label: Create database
tool.create_database.desc: Create a database (attribute view) block at the end of the given document; optionally name it and predefine columns (select/mSelect columns may include preset options). Use the returned database_id for subsequent row/column operations.
tool.create_database.p.parent_document_i: Parent document ID (the database is appended to this document)
tool.create_database.p.name: Database name (optional)
tool.create_database.insertFailed: Failed to insert the database block
tool.create_database.noAvId: Failed to obtain the kernel-assigned database ID
tool.insert_block.p.next_id: ID of the following block; the new block is inserted before it (with parent_id, inserts at the very top)
skillSqlDesc: Query SiYuan's SQLite index directly with query_sql for precise stats/filtering: blocks/attributes/refs schema and query templates
skillBackupDesc: Create a snapshot before batch delete/move/rewrite so mistakes can be rolled back
skillTagsDesc: Clean up the tag system: find duplicate/similar tags, propose merges, then batch-rename and remove
skillOrganizeDesc: Reorganize folders: inventory contents, propose an archiving plan, then batch move/rename after confirmation
